invariants.rationale: A new HashMap is always created and returned, so result cannot be null.
The method always returns a Map object.
If partitionPaths is null or empty, result is empty; otherwise, result has at most as many entries as partitionPaths.
For each partition, even if there are no small files, it appears a non-null list is used (from getSmallFiles).
All keys in the map must be from the input partitionPaths list if it is not null.
